novel_features.name: Async Generation Watcher
novel_features.description: Poll until generation completes, then print gammaUrl and credits. Bridges the async gap without manual polling.
novel_features.rationale: The Gamma API returns a generationId immediately; callers must poll GET /v1.0/generations/{id} manually. The --watch flag automates this.
novel_features.example: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "Q3 product roadmap" --format presentation --watch --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use whenever you start a generation and need the final gammaUrl in one command, without a separate polling loop.

novel_features.name: Export Auto-Downloader
novel_features.description: After --watch completes, download the exportUrl to a local directory with the gammaId as filename.
novel_features.rationale: The export URL is only available after generation completes. --download chains --watch with a file download, eliminating the manual curl step.
novel_features.example: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "AI market overview" --format document --watch --download /tmp/gamma-exports/ --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you need the exported file locally for further processing without a separate download step.

novel_features.name: Sharing Preset Shorthand
novel_features.description: Map a preset name (private, view-link, edit-link, workspace-view) to the workspaceAccess + externalAccess flag pair.
novel_features.rationale: Gamma's API uses separate workspaceAccess and externalAccess flags. --sharing collapses common combinations into a single mnemonic flag.
novel_features.example: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "Q4 investor update" --format presentation --sharing view-link --watch --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use instead of specifying two separate access flags when the sharing intent is a standard preset.

novel_features.name: Image Source Shorthand
novel_features.description: Short alias for --image-options-source that sets the AI model for image generation without the nested flag path.
novel_features.rationale: --image-options-source is a deeply nested flag path. --image-source is a cleaner alias for the most common use case.
novel_features.example: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "Product launch slides" --format presentation --image-source aiGenerated --watch --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to specify image generation method without remembering the nested flag path.

narrative.headline: Generate polished presentations, documents, and webpages from a text prompt — with one-command async polling and auto-download.
narrative.value_prop: Gamma generates AI-powered presentations, documents, and webpages from a text prompt. The CLI adds async-wait-and-download as a single command, sharing preset shorthands, and image-source aliases — all using --watch --download --sharing --image-source.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set GAMMA_API_KEY from gamma.app/settings. Run 'gamma-pp-cli auth set-token <key>' to persist it.

quickstart.comment: Verify the CLI is installed and auth key is configured

quickstart.command: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "Q3 2025 product roadmap: new features, timeline, owners" --format presentation --watch --agent
quickstart.comment: Generate a presentation and wait for completion

quickstart.command: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "AI market overview for investors" --format document --watch --download /tmp/gamma-exports/ --agent
quickstart.comment: Generate a document and download the export
List available themes to use in generations

quickstart.command: gamma-pp-cli generations create --input-text "Startup pitch deck" --format presentation --sharing view-link --image-source aiGenerated --watch --agent
quickstart.comment: Generate with sharing preset and AI images

troubleshoots.fix: export GAMMA_API_KEY=<your-key> or run: gamma-pp-cli auth set-token <key>
Increase --wait-timeout (default 10m). Long documents can take several minutes.
Use --watch with --download — download requires a completed generation with an exportUrl.

narrative.when_to_use: Use Gamma when you need to create a polished presentation, document, or webpage from a text prompt or outline. It is the right tool for pitch decks, reports, onboarding docs, and any visual output that needs professional formatting. Do not use it for raw data analysis (use Exa/Valyu), pure image generation (use Fal AI), or video (use Fal AI).
anti_triggers: Raw data analysis or search — use Exa or Valyu instead
Image-only generation without a document structure — use Fal AI instead
Video generation — use Fal AI instead
